findings.where: research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-DING-25.result.json, item PAPER-DING-25/4.2-global-triangulation (accepted source route 5), exported to PhiGammaModulesAndIwasawaCohomology:PG.7
findings.claim: The extracted theorem replaces compatible triangulation data and a suitable base point by a bare Zariski-dense set of pointwise trianguline fibres. It claims that a family of Galois representations over any reduced affinoid with such fibres is trianguline after shrinking. That is not the hypothesis package of the cited Ding application or KPX theorem: Ding has an ordered analytic character family and a noncritical, phi-generic point, while KPX requires densely pointwise STRICT triangulinity with fixed ordered analytic parameters. The item must not be exported as the broader theorem currently written.
findings.evidence: Ding, published PMIHES 142 (2025), proof of Proposition 4.17, p. 69, https://pmihes.centre-mersenne.org/item/10.1007/s10240-025-00156-2.pdf (read 2026-09-26): after constructing rho_X and the natural ordered character delta_X, the argument invokes Bergdall because D is "non-critical and (φ-)generic". It obtains successive extensions with parameters delta_X,i times |.|_K^(2i-(n+1)) epsilon^(1-i), after shrinking around the specified point. KPX, published JAMS text hosted at https://www.mathi.uni-heidelberg.de/~otmar/lehre/seminare/KPX.pdf (read 2026-09-26), Definition 6.3.2, pp. 1102-1103, requires global continuous ordered characters delta_1,...,delta_d whose specializations give strict triangulations on the dense subset. Corollary 6.3.10, p. 1108, says "with respect to the ordered parameters" and supplies a proper birational modification, a coherent filtration and an exceptional closed locus; graded pieces embed into the parameter modules tensored with line bundles. Pointwise existence of unspecified triangulations omits this compatibility data. The older arXiv v3 additionally assumes irreducible connected components; the published corollary does not, so that older restriction is NOT part of the requested repair.
findings.fix: Keep PG.7 as owner. Replace the item with Ding Proposition 4.17 proof's local eigenvariety application, carrying its ambient hypotheses, the ordered analytic characters (including the twists), and the noncritical phi-generic base point. If the item is instead intended as a general KPX export, separately state published Definition 6.3.2 and Corollary 6.3.10, including strict triangulinity with global ordered parameters, proper birational modification, exceptional locus and line-bundle graded pieces. A shrinking-only corollary must specify the locus retained and justify passage from that theorem; do not promise a triangulation near an arbitrary prescribed point from density alone. No change to the source papers or the owner graph is requested.
